description: A mysterious and pretty transfer student who started attending the M.M.R. Vocational School. Although her stated purpose is to organize the old files in the library, all she really thinks about is making the most out of the only youth she'll ever have in life.

lines.text: Should we run away together? Our youth is short, we can't stay trapped in this tiny classroom forever.
Ooh, this angle's great! Let me take a quick photo.
Hey, did you do your homework...? I didn't do mine. Will you take the blame with me?
I've always wanted to go on a date in our uniforms. What do you say? Will you be my boyfriend?
If you were my teacher, at least I'd get to see you every day.
Quick question! Are you dating anyone? This is more important to me than the test!
Excuse me! I'm right here! You didn't forget me, did you?
I skipped class to come here, but you aren't going to look at me? Even when I look this cute? Seriously?
I'm late, I'm late! Wait, I'm out of bread?
Let's take a picture together. I like the buildings here. They're so pretty.
You know, I think going on a secret date here would be pretty fun.
Let's have the best days of our lives.
I think I prefer being the one protected.
Have you ever heard of the Invincible High School Girl?
I can't get too smart! I think being a little airheaded is kinda attractive.
This must be how people ask each other out these days. I love it.
Do you maybe like me? You always give me such perfect gifts, so I was just wondering...
I got you a gift too. Go on, open it. I'm waiting.
I like you. I could say it a hundred, even a thousand times.
Ugh! I can't take it anymore. I just want to shower you with kisses!
Are you even human? Seriously, how can you be this cool?
But I'm a high schooler. Do I really have to go...?
Yes...?
Aww, I don't wanna go...
All right, fine. Come at me!
I'm putting my trust in you...!
Witness the Invincible High School Girl!
*Huff... huff...!* I've got this!
One, two...!
Am I doing this right? Really?
Wait... I need a breather.
I'm ready.
I'll treasure this moment forever.
Here it comes! My finishing move!
Did you see that? Did you see it?
All right!
Are there any more?
Eek!
Oww...
Hmph!
I didn't... want you to see me like this...
Class is over! Can we go have fun now? Please?
